rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: After the Dagestan commission corrected its protocol on 11 July 1996, the CEC notes that the changes to that protocol and to the CEC protocol on the results of the 3 July 1996 repeat voting do not affect the result of the election nationally, and sets revised data for the CEC protocol of 9 July 1996: 108,589,050 voters on the lists; 74,800,449 took part; 'ЕЛЬЦИН Борис Николаевич' 40,203,948 (instead of 40,208,384); 'ЗЮГАНОВ Геннадий Андреевич' 30,102,288 (instead of 30,113,306); against all 3,604,462.
